_meta.purpose: Real regulatory citations. A generated process may only cite a regulation listed here. validate_process() logs anything else.

regulations.title: Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems
regulations.note: Current operating framework for small drones. BVLOS requires a waiver under 107.31 (visual line of sight) among others.

regulations.title: Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations of Unmanned Aircraft Systems
regulations.note: NPRM ONLY. Published 7 Aug 2025; comments closed 6 Oct 2025 (3,000+ responses); reopened 28 Jan-11 Feb 2026 for right-of-way and electronic conspicuity; in OIRA review since 10 Jul 2026; unpublished as of 29 Aug 2026. Covers ops up to 1,320 lb, two approval levels (Permitted Operations, Operational Certificate), five risk categories by population density. NO operator holds Part 108 authority.

regulations.title: Operating Requirements: Commuter and On-Demand Operations
regulations.note: Air carrier certificate. Held by Amazon Prime Air, DoorDash Air and Archer Aviation. The certification route for eVTOL air-taxi commercial service.

regulations.title: Certification Procedures for Products and Articles
regulations.note: Type certification basis. Joby cleared Stage 4 of the 5-stage process late March 2026; Archer completed Phase 3 of 4.

regulations.title: Authorisation for FAA-conducted certification flight test
regulations.note: Joby began flight testing its first conforming aircraft toward TIA in March 2026.

regulations.title: Urban Air Mobility Concept of Operations, version 2.0
regulations.note: Defines UAM Corridors, the PSU role, and that within UAM Corridors strategic deconfliction and tactical separation occur without direct ATC involvement. Vertiports supply information for planning but do not themselves provide strategic deconfliction.

regulations.title: Standard Specification for UTM UAS Service Supplier (USS) Interoperability
regulations.note: Safety case limited to strategic deconfliction, accomplished via the Strategic Coordination role.

regulations.title: UAS Traffic Management statutory basis
Authorising Drivered and Driverless AV passenger service pilot programs
regulations.note: 31 May 2018. Basis of California's AV passenger service programme. CPUC issued the first deployment permits in San Francisco in 2022, later expanded to Los Angeles. AVs are classified as TNCs by the CPUC. A new CPUC rulemaking is open to build comprehensive AV passenger transportation policy.

regulations.title: Autonomous vehicle testing and deployment
regulations.note: CA DMV Autonomous Vehicle Deployment Permit is required in addition to CPUC authority — a dual-permit path.

regulations.title: CA DMV autonomous vehicle disengagement and collision reporting
regulations.note: Mandatory annual disengagement report and collision reporting for permit holders. Source of the disengagement-per-mile KPI.

regulations.title: Protect App-Based Drivers and Services Act
regulations.note: Upheld unanimously by the California Supreme Court on 25 July 2024. Allows app-based transportation and delivery network companies to classify drivers as independent contractors subject to conditions, including an earnings guarantee of 120% of California minimum wage for engaged time. CA minimum wage is $16.90/hr from 1 January 2026.

regulations.title: ABC test for worker classification
regulations.note: Prop 22 carves app-based network companies out of AB 5's ABC test.

regulations.title: Transportation Network Company regulation
regulations.note: CPUC TNC licensing, insurance and reporting regime.

regulations.title: Open Mobility Foundation right-of-way management APIs
regulations.note: Provider, Agency and Policy APIs. Steering committee includes Populus, Lacuna, Ride Report, Blue Systems and Kiwibot. All MDS-compatible feeds must also expose a public GBFS feed for micromobility and carshare modes.

regulations.title: MobilityData public real-time availability feed
regulations.note: Mandatory public companion feed to MDS.

regulations.citation: UNECE WP.29 Automated Driving Systems regulation
regulations.title: First global regulations for fully automated driving systems
regulations.note: Adopted June 2026 by the UN Economic Commission for Europe World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations.

regulations.citation: US DOT 2026 Unified Rulemaking Agenda (ADS items)
regulations.title: Federal AV rulemaking acceleration
regulations.note: Released 7 July 2026, containing multiple automated driving system items.

regulations.title: Public accommodation accessibility
regulations.note: Basis for WAV (wheelchair accessible vehicle) service obligations and accessible-app requirements.

regulations.title: EU General Data Protection Regulation
regulations.note: Applies to Bolt and Lime European operations; location data is personal data.

regulations.title: California Consumer Privacy Act as amended
regulations.note: Tension point with MDS: cities requesting granular trip data vs. precise geolocation as sensitive personal information.

regulations.title: Independent contractor and third-party network tax reporting
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
Periodic reporting
regulations.note: Applies to Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Joby, Archer and — since its July 2026 Nasdaq IPO — Lime.

regulations.title: Corporate carbon accounting standard
Lithium battery transport and safety standards
regulations.note: Governs scooter and e-bike battery handling, shipping and end-of-life.
